review.official:
One of
Rhodes Island's
core
Operators
. On the battlefield, Noir Corne rushes to the
vanguard
to protect his teammates, but back at the Ark, he quietly dedicates himself to logistical duties.

files.description:
Radiological scan showed blurred outlines of internal organs with visible abnormalities. Originium Particle Test of circulation system indicated Oripathy. The subject is confirmed to be infected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 11%
No major infection symptoms have yet appeared. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.22u/L
Severity of infection remains low, with no major hindrance on motor functions.

A veteran Operator of Rhodes Island in both age and experience, Noir Corne's habit of wearing a mask often makes him seem unapproachable. However, those who converse with him quickly find that he is an easygoing, brotherly figure who gets along well with his juniors and never touts his seniority.

Noir Corne keeps a huge collection of masks in his room. He'll wear the most suitable mask for each occasion. 
The mask he is seen with most frequently also seems to be his favorite. In his own words, 'This one best suits Rhodes Island's ambience.' 
By the way, his mask does not hide any terrible secrets.

The most peculiar thing about Noir Corne's personality is his caution around Yato - not fear, but a conspicuous, careful deference so as to avoid angering her - which has spawned plenty of gossip among the operators. 
However, neither their backgrounds nor their interactions seem to clarify why.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: What's up, Doctor? Me, I'm just on standby.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: My shield? Fun fact: I personally provide a portion of the energy it needs.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: What I look like beneath the mask? Well, I... Actually, let's keep it secret for a bit longer.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Man, nothing better than a break after you finish a mission.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, if I get to know you better, I figure my shield's gonna get even sturdier.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Course I know where my limit's at. But I don't want Yato to worry about me, which is what matters. We'll worry about the rest some other time!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: There's always the need for guys like me, you know? Nah, I'm not trying to act high and mighty. What I'm saying is: when you have a VIP plus a lot of danger, you need a guy to stand between them, that's all.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Sometimes you've just gotta take off the mask and catch a breather.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Defender Noir Corne, reporting for duty. You need VIP protection, I'm your guy.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Cool... So this stuff is what Grandpa Rangers was talking about earlier.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: We bringing friends?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm gonna get even stronger!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Holding the line is a Defender's most important job!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: We're doing it!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: C'mon, say something.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: What's up?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I've got this!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Here I come!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Watch it, buddy!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Reinforce defenses!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Even guys like me are happy to get through tough battles like these.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: That was all right.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Well, we managed.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: This wouldn't have happened if I'd worn my good mask! God dammit!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Alright, let's take a breather.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You wanna get some drinks after work?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: It's these kinds of days I love the most. Everyone has a blast getting together, and we're off work. C'mon, Doctor, you gotta try this burdenbeast offal flambé while it's still fresh from the pan! Whoa, whoa, I don't think Dr. Kal'tsit's gonna like you drinking that much, y'know?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Nothing outta the ordinary, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Yo, Doctor! Here's a mask from my stash, straight to you! You've rocked the hood for long enough, right? You could try masking up, just for today. Think about it! And hey, if no one else is gonna say it, I will—I think you'll look cool as hell with it on.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: With all the years I've spent at Rhodes Island, I know exactly what's left on the agenda today. The Doctor's still got mad business, alright? Can't keep 'em any longer. Everyone, a toast to the Doctor, who's spent another year working hard for us! To you!
